label: Tecnologia & SaaS Widescreen (30s) · Demo Rápida de Produto
description: Vídeo demonstrativo em 16:9 widescreen: interface moderna em dark mode, automação de tarefas com 1 clique e gráficos de produtividade subindo em tempo real.
resources: sound design tátil de clique de mouse e confirmação digital

scenes.prompt: Cinematic 16:9 widescreen SaaS product motion. Ultra-clean dark mode dashboard UI floating on an isometric 3D glass plane. A cursor smoothly glides and clicks the glowing blue 'Auto-Sync' button. Non-verbal sound design: crisp mechanical mouse click and swift data spark. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: AUTOMATIZE EM 1 CLIQUE.

Cinematic 16:9 widescreen SaaS product motion. Instant workflow transformation: chaotic spreadsheets transform smoothly into clean Kanban cards and glowing real-time analytics graphs. Non-verbal sound design: satisfying fast card shuffle and affirmative digital chime. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: FLUXO 10X MAIS RÁPIDO.

Cinematic 16:9 widescreen SaaS product motion. Team collaboration icons connecting around a shared central project board, showing 100% completed progress bar in radiant emerald green. Non-verbal sound design: task completion chime and energy hum. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: EQUIPE SINCRONIZADA.

Cinematic 16:9 widescreen SaaS outro screen. Sleek software logo with bold typography: 'Teste grátis por 14 dias sem cartão de crédito'. Non-verbal sound design: solid tech punch chord. No speech or dialogue. On-screen text: COMECE SEU TESTE GRÁTIS.
